import Mathlib.Algebra.MonoidAlgebra.Degree
import Mathlib.Algebra.MvPolynomial.Eval
import Mathlib.Order.ConditionallyCompleteLattice.Finset
import Mathlib.Basic.Real.Basic
import Mathlib.Data.Finsupp.Weight
import Mathlib.RingTheory.MvPowerSeries.NoZeroDivisors
import Mathlib.Tactic
import Mathlib.Algebra.Polynomial.RingDivision
import Mathlib.Algebra.Polynomial.Taylor
import Mathlib.Algebra.MvPolynomial.NoZeroDivisors
import Mathlib.LinearAlgebra.FreeModule.PID

#check_failure Roth.exists_sum_mul_eq_gcd
#check @Finset.gcd_eq_sum_mul
#check @Ideal.mem_span_range_iff_exists_fun
namespace Bezout170
 theorem original {ι : Type*} (s : Finset ι) (u : ι → ℤ) :
    ∃ z : ι → ℤ, ∑ i ∈ s, z i * u i = s.gcd u := by
  simpa only [eq_comm, mul_comm] using Finset.gcd_eq_sum_mul s u
 theorem general {R ι : Type*} [CommRing R] [IsBezout R] [NormalizedGCDMonoid R]
    (s : Finset ι) (u : ι → R) : ∃ z : ι → R, ∑ i ∈ s, z i * u i = s.gcd u := by
  simpa only [eq_comm, mul_comm] using Finset.gcd_eq_sum_mul s u
 theorem caller {ι : Type*} {s : Finset ι} {u : ι → ℤ} (hu : s.gcd u = 1)
    {v : ℚ} (hv : ∀ a ∈ s, ∃ z : ℤ, (u a : ℚ) * v = z) : ∃ z : ℤ, v = z := by
  classical
  obtain ⟨z, hz⟩ := Finset.gcd_eq_sum_mul s u
  rw [hu] at hz
  choose! w hw using hv
  refine ⟨∑ i ∈ s, z i * w i, ?_⟩
  calc v = ((∑ i ∈ s, u i * z i : ℤ) : ℚ) * v := by simp [← hz]
    _ = ((∑ i ∈ s, z i * w i : ℤ) : ℚ) := by
        push_cast
        rw [Finset.sum_mul]
        exact Finset.sum_congr rfl fun i hi ↦ by rw [mul_comm (u i), mul_assoc, hw i hi]
#print axioms original
#print axioms general
#print axioms caller
end Bezout170
